quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #15
										  					
  

35 Questions • Passing Score 28

questions.question: The first thing that alcohol affects is:
questions.explanation: Alcohol affects your brain first. It damages the parts of your brain that control good decisions and driving skills. This makes you unsafe to drive.

questions.question: For drivers age 21 or older, it is illegal to drive with a blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of:
questions.explanation: At 0.08 percent BAC or higher, it is illegal for drivers age 21 or older to drive. Driving while under the influence of alcohol is illegal and dangerous.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you:

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down, look and listen for trains, and be ready to stop. Do not cross until all trains have passed.

questions.question: What message will be found on a red octagon-shaped sign?
questions.explanation: A red octagon (eight-sided) sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at this sign.

questions.question: When changing lanes, you should never:

options.text: Look over your shoulder to check your blind spot.
Check for other vehicles moving into the same lane.

questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check your mirrors and blind spots to make sure no vehicles are there. Always use your turn signal to warn other drivers. Never change lanes suddenly.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road will turn sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.question: This yellow sign means:

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you of a sharp right turn ahead.

questions.question: If your car breaks down on the highway, you should:

options.text: Park with all four wheels off the traveled highway, if possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Park with all four wheels off the traveled highway, if possible.
questions.explanation: When your vehicle breaks down, move it off the road if you can. Park with all four wheels away from the main road to keep traffic flowing safely.

questions.question: After stopping and yielding to traffic and pedestrians, you may turn left at a red light from a one-way street onto another one-way street with traffic moving left.
questions.explanation: You may turn left at a red light when turning from a one-way street onto another one-way street with traffic moving left. You must first stop and give the right-of-way to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road or entrance. If you see this sign, traffic is coming toward you. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to possible dangers ahead. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming. Slow down and be ready to turn or stop.

questions.question: Before entering a curve, what should you do?
questions.explanation: You must slow down for curves. You can drive slower than the posted speed limit if conditions require it, but you cannot drive faster. Slow down for curves, hills with limited visibility, slippery roads, and areas with pedestrians or animals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn of hazards. Orange signs are used for construction and maintenance areas.

questions.question: You are driving behind a motorcycle and want to pass. What must you do?

options.text: Stay in the right lane since the motorcycle is small and doesn't use all of the lane.
Honk to make the motorcycle move to the shoulder so you can pass.
Move your entire vehicle into the left lane before passing and stay there during the pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move your entire vehicle into the left lane before passing and stay there during the pass.
questions.explanation: Give a motorcycle a full lane when passing. Never share a lane with a motorcycle. If you move back too soon, the rider may be forced to swerve right into traffic or off the road.

questions.question: Teen drivers can have only two passengers under age 20 in the vehicle during their first 12 months of driving.
questions.explanation: Teen drivers (ages 16-17) can have only one passenger under age 20 during their first 12 months of driving. This rule does not apply to siblings, step-siblings, children, or stepchildren of the driver.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns of a school zone or school crossing.

questions.question: When you see this yellow sign, what should you do?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guard signals you to go.
Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school. Watch carefully and stop if children are crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a pedestrian crosswalk is ahead.

questions.question: At night, an oncoming vehicle has its high beams on and you cannot see the road. What should you do?

options.text: Look toward the left edge of your lane.
Look toward the right edge of your lane.
Look straight ahead in your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look toward the right edge of your lane.
questions.explanation: Do not look directly at oncoming headlights. Instead, look toward the right edge of your lane and watch the other vehicle from the corner of your eye.

questions.question: When passing parked vehicles, what should you do?

options.text: Be ready for a person or vehicle to suddenly move into your lane.
Expect all drivers and pedestrians to respect your right-of-way.
Drive close to the parked vehicles to leave more room for moving traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready for a person or vehicle to suddenly move into your lane.
questions.explanation: Keep space between your vehicle and parked cars. Someone may step out without looking. A driver may start their vehicle without seeing you coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic may merge from the right. Be ready to let other traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds in a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet. Slow down to stay safe.

questions.question: Motorcyclists are entitled to use the full width of a traffic lane. A driver should pass a motorcycle the same way a driver would pass another vehicle.
questions.explanation: Motorcyclists need the full lane to maneuver safely. Do not share a lane with a motorcycle, even if there seems to be enough room.

questions.question: Give the right-of-way to pedestrians who are:
questions.explanation: Always yield to pedestrians crossing the street, whether in a marked crosswalk or not. This keeps everyone safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers to watch for bicycles and other traffic crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that pedestrians may cross ahead. Stop and wait if a pedestrian is in the crosswalk.

questions.question: Driving at night using only your parking lights is unlawful.
questions.explanation: You must use your headlights when driving at night. Using only parking lights is illegal.

questions.question: You want to park downhill on a two-way road with no curb. Which way should you turn your front wheels?

options.text: Right, toward the side of the road
Left, toward the center of the road

questions.correctAnswerText: Right, toward the side of the road
questions.explanation: When parking downhill with or without a curb, turn your wheels right toward the edge. If your brakes fail, your car will roll away from traffic. When parking uphill on a road with a curb, turn wheels left toward the center so the car rolls into the curb.

questions.question: You are driving on a one-way street. You may turn left onto another one-way street only if:

options.text: You increase your speed before the turn.
Traffic on the street moves to the right.
Traffic on the street moves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic on the street moves to the left.
questions.explanation: You can turn left onto a one-way street where traffic moves to the left, unless a sign says no. You cannot turn left onto a one-way street where traffic moves to the right.

questions.question: A red traffic light is showing, but a police officer directs you to go through the intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Stop until the light turns green.
Go through the intersection without stopping.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Go through the intersection without stopping.
questions.explanation: Always follow a police officer's directions. A police officer directing traffic overrides all traffic signals and signs.

questions.question: What should you use when driving in fog?
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog. High beams reflect back at you and make it harder to see.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow line next to a broken yellow line mean?

options.text: Vehicles in both directions may pass.
The vehicle next to the broken line may pass.
The vehicle next to the solid line may pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle next to the broken line may pass.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. A broken yellow line means you can pass. A solid yellow line means you cannot pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is put on slow-moving vehicles.

questions.question: You want to turn left at the next corner. Who has the right-of-way?

options.text: Oncoming vehicles that are also turning left.
Pedestrians on the sidewalk waiting for the walk signal.

questions.explanation: When turning left, you must let pedestrians, bicyclists, and oncoming vehicles go first.

questions.question: When should you increase the distance between your vehicle and the car ahead?

options.text: When following a small passenger vehicle.
When another driver is tailgating you.
When you are driving slower than the speed limit.

questions.correctAnswerText: When another driver is tailgating you.
questions.explanation: If someone is tailgating you, add extra space in front of your vehicle. Slow down gradually or change lanes. Do not brake suddenly, as this could cause a crash.
